title: galium trifidum var. tinctorium
intro: Galium trifidum var. tinctorium, commonly known as Woodruff, is a perennial herb belonging to the Rubiaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antispasmodic properties, which can help soothe digestive issues, reduce pain and inflammation, and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of Galium trifidum var. tinctorium include coumarin, which is responsible for its medicinal properties, and other compounds like flavonoids and phenolic acids. The therapeutic actions of this plant include calming the nervous system, reducing anxiety and stress, and promoting a restful sleep, making it a valuable natural remedy for promoting overall well-being.
